facts.fact: 贝克斯当面揭穿安吉拉躲在灌木丛里跟踪三人，并说她一路跟到塞雷娜·萨克森家、藏在迈克办公室后面
facts.anchor: You were spying on us from the bushes

facts.fact: 安吉拉承认自己一直知道两起谋杀之间的关联，只是没说
facts.anchor: I know what the link between the two murders is

facts.fact: 四人从公园转往牧师住宅谈事情
facts.anchor: Becks suggested that they go to the vicarage

facts.fact: 安吉拉指认哈莱福德勋爵是杀害加里·怀斯和迈克·萨克森的凶手
facts.anchor: it’s my belief that he killed Gary Wise and Mike Saxon

facts.fact: 安吉拉回忆威廉当时反复追问能否拿迈克的把柄来要挟他
facts.anchor: Was it possible someone could use leverage against him?

facts.fact: 安吉拉说威廉那天提到三位名人，其中两位已经死了，第三位是她自己
facts.anchor: two of them are now dead, and the third one’s me

facts.fact: 安吉拉说这次下午茶发生在初夏
facts.anchor: At the beginning of the summer.

facts.fact: 朱迪思提议直接登门去问哈莱福德勋爵
facts.anchor: We just have to go to Lord Harleyford’s house
